to.invalid: Not a valid wallet address or ENS name.
to.riskUnavailable: Risk check unavailable — services offline. Verify the recipient manually.

risk.reportedDetail: Flagged by the risk service for reported scam activity. Sending is blocked.
risk.knownDetail: Known recipient in your address book · address format valid.
risk.firstTimeDetail: Not in your address book — verify the address carefully before sending.

review.riskUnavailable: Risk check unavailable — verify the recipient manually before sending.
review.trustNote: Only the public recipient address is checked by the backend. Your private keys are used to sign locally and never leave this device.

mismatch.title: Network mismatch
mismatch.body: You're sending on {{from}}, but this recipient is known on {{to}}. Funds sent to the wrong network may be lost.

sim.title: Transaction simulation
sim.failedBody: Simulation reverted — the transaction is likely to fail (insufficient gas). Adjust the amount or try again when the testnet RPC is responsive.
sim.unavailableBody: Couldn't simulate — wallet services are offline. You can still sign locally, but the outcome can't be previewed.
sim.note: Simulation runs against testnet and does not move funds.

overlay.failedBody: The transaction reverted on-chain — it ran out of gas before completing. No funds were moved.
